input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: The positional-arguments help section now passes each argument's get_help_record result straight to write_dl. For an Argument with no help text, that record is (metavar, None), not (metavar, ""), so write_dl receives a None description.
- rationale: Trigger: a command with at least one positional argument that has help set and another positional argument with help left unset, so the section is rendered. Mechanism: the removed code substituted (make_metavar, "") for falsy records, but the new code no longer does, and get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) with self.help being None. write_dl then measures and wraps the None value, which click's text helpers do not accept, so it raises TypeError. Impact: --help crashes for such commands instead of printing the usage text.
critique: The finding gives the same mechanism as the label. get_help_record returns (metavar, None) for an argument without help, format_arguments passes it to write_dl with no fallback, and the TypeError crashes --help when one argument has help and another does not.
